title: A/B testing push notifications
summary: This page explains how Service NSW uses A/B testing for push notifications to improve digital services.

faqs.a: A/B testing is a method used to compare two versions of something (like a webpage or notification) to see which one performs better with users.

faqs.q: How does Service NSW use A/B testing?
faqs.a: Service NSW uses A/B testing to improve the effectiveness of its digital services, such as push notifications, by testing different approaches.

faqs.q: Why is A/B testing important for Service NSW?
faqs.a: It helps Service NSW understand what works best for users, ensuring that digital services are as useful and easy to use as possible.
